description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing MikroTik routers via tik4net. mikrotik_call runs any RouterOS command over every tik4net transport (API/REST/Telnet/SSH/MAC-Telnet/WinBox CLI/WinBox native, including the MAC-layer variants) with an optional per-transport raw protocol trace; mikrotik_cli_complete enumerates a menu's writable fields via RouterOS Tab-completion; mikrotik_discover finds routers on the local segment via MNDP, without host or credentials.
